corrections.reason: Visual and grammatical check: the printed glyph has the symmetrical legs of 1st-order ደ ('እንደታየው' - 'as it appeared to Abba Pachomius'), not 4th-order ዳ.
Canonical Ge'ez citation of Matthew 24:29 ('ወእምድኅረ ሕማሞሙ ለእማንቱ መዋዕል') and visual verification: the glyph after ሞ is clearly 2nd-order ሙ ('ሕማሞሙ'), not ን.
